report_summary: Strong, mostly careful narrative connects timed answer exchange to evaluation independence without claiming measured score changes. It distinguishes participant-reported bypasses, uncertain affiliation and unconfirmed XSS, and correctly identifies 26 moderation restorations. Its blanket claim that no content exists after deletion overlooks retained post-deletion saves.
